intelligence.human_view: Think of it like a kitchen with ten half-cooked dishes. You don't start an eleventh — you finish the ten on the stove, plate them, and serve them. He gave us the About, the Skills, the Personal, the Memberships — those get done, all the way done, before he hands us anything else. No new work rides on top of unfinished work.
intelligence.simple_view: Finish what you started! No new games until the ones you are playing are done! The About, the Skills, the Memberships — finish them first, all the way, and then we can start something new!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you finish what you started, dear, before you start anything new! The About, the Skills, the Memberships — you get them all done, love, every one of them, and then, dear, then you can begin the next thing!
intelligence.naya_view: Complete the open rounds before dispatching anything new. The About, the Skills in the Personal, the Memberships — every open round is finished, whole, proven on the page he sees, before any new brief goes out. No new dispatch rides on top of unfinished work. A round that is open is owed, and owed work is finished before new work is begun.
